programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A newly single real estate professional looks to buy a place she can make her own in Milwaukee; she's searching for a house that will accommodate her sister, who will be moving in.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The team must use a little ingenuity to convert a large timber-frame barn in their hometown of Lewisburg, W.V.

programs.title: Building Off The Grid
programs.desc: A couple plans to build a unique outdoor living space in Colorado by using donkeys to get materials to the top of their steep build site. When their plans go haywire, however, they are left scrambling for solutions to finish the project.

programs.title: Building Alaska
programs.desc: Chappie Cook's team runs into bears and sinking boats while hauling scaffolding materials; Jeff Erickson carefully begins to construct his slippery roof; Chris Sewell works tirelessly to install all the timber walls of his cabin.

programs.title: Building Roots
programs.desc: Two siblings love their Colorado legacy home, but the structure and decor is the same as when it was purchased 35 years ago by their late parents. Now, Ben and Cristi transform the property into a mountain lodge suited for their large family gatherings.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A woman with Welsh roots moves her family to Wales to begin graduate school in music. She also recently discovered she's pregnant, and they're looking for a place with four bedrooms, and something that's near her school.
